card.text: Proxima Centauri b was found in 2016 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Proxima Centauri b"
sources.quote: Proxima Centauri b, also referred to as Proxima b, or Alpha Centauri Cb, is an exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star Proxima Centauri in the constellation Centaurus.

introduction.text: Orbital orientation unknown: the 47° plane is assumed. The map is a ROCKE-3D climate scenario; no atmosphere or ocean has been detected.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A neutral sphere at an estimated radius; no surface image is measured. Orbit orientation is unknown (47° assumed).

climate-model.title: ROCKE-3D control
climate-model.summary: Simulated surface air temperature with an assumed ocean and atmosphere. Neither is detected; orbital orientation is unknown.

static-ocean-model.title: ROCKE-3D, no ocean currents
static-ocean-model.summary: Like the control run but the ocean carries no heat. Warm water stays under the star, the night side freezes.

early-earth-air-model.title: ROCKE-3D, Archean High
early-earth-air-model.summary: Like the control run with early Earth's greenhouse gases: 1% carbon dioxide, 0.2% methane. Warmer, with less ice.

earth-land-model.title: ROCKE-3D, Earth's continents
earth-land-model.summary: Like the control run but with Earth's continents, Africa under the star. Land, not Proxima b's, is assumed.

model-wind.title: ROCKE-3D control, wind
model-wind.summary: Surface wind speed in the control run, in false color. Winds blow in toward the point under the star.
